idea-plugin.name: Runtime Object to JSON
idea-plugin.description:
Exports the runtime value of a Java variable to a formatted JSON file while the debugger is suspended.

Place the cursor on a Java variable, right-click in the editor, and select Export Object to JSON.

The same command automatically recognizes runtime fields, injected dependencies, Spring components and methods annotated with @Bean. For already initialized singleton beans it reads the Spring ApplicationContext via the suspended JVM and does not initialize lazy beans. Collections, maps, and common JDK scalar types use readable JSON snapshots; sensitive field names are redacted by default.

action.description: Exports the runtime value of a Java variable to JSON
